arguments.value: Bank of America Corporation and Banc of America Preferred Funding Corporation agree to jointly file any reports or amendments each is required to file under Sections 13 or 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and to attach this agreement as an exhibit to those filings with the SEC and, if applicable, the relevant exchange. The agreement remains effective until one party gives the others signed written notice revoking it, and any revocation applies only to the party that revokes. The source does not state a governing law.
